items.text: Videos received by Iran International show a group of students in the Motekhasesin neighborhood of Kermanshah city on Saturday, 30 Aban, came to the streets and shouted "Sogand Sayadi." According to reports, government forces beat them.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International reporting a 66% increase in hamburger prices over six months: "It has risen from 475,400 tomans in Esfand 1404 to 790,000 tomans in Mehr 1405."
